natural_body: 40% discount lifts acquisition and revenue but cuts 30-day retention 12%; use selectively.

first.rationale: Prioritize a targeted onboarding-simplification experiment: both inherited findings indicate durable activation and adoption gains, and it directly addresses the current decline in onboarding completion and activation. This is more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than broad discounting, whose retention cost is already documented. Verify the two archived onboarding records before committing to confirm segment scope, effect size, and implementation details.
